synthesis:draft.headline: Actual operational demand was 6812.0 MW at 2026-08-20 09:30 AEST (UTC+1000); the run's POE50 was 6493.0 MW, POE10 6753.0 MW and POE90 6233.0 MW — actual was above POE10.
summary: For the half-hour ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z (2026-08-20 09:30 AEST (UTC+1000)) the recorded operational demand was 6812.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0624).

The selected forecast run (PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608192200_20260819213203, issued 2026-08-19T11:26:58Z) gave POE50 = 6493.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0623), POE10 = 6753.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0627) and POE90 = 6233.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0628).

The forecast vs actual classification for that half-hour is recorded as "above POE10" and the forecast error (POE50 − actual) is −319.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0625; error_pct −4.68%, evidence_id: ev0626).
Overall MAE for the 24 half-hours in the review window for this run is 139.62 MW (evidence_id: ev0701).

possible_explanations.statement: The actual being above POE10 for 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z may reflect higher-than-forecast evening demand for that half-hour (compare evidence ev0624, ev0627, ev0623).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare POE50/POE10 values for 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z across other forecast runs and subsequent runs' pairs for the same target to see if multiple runs predicted lower POE50 than the observed actual (use the run pairs returned by compare_forecast_actual for this region and window).

possible_explanations.statement: The negative error (POE50 − actual = −319.0 MW) might indicate a short-term bias in the forecast run for late-evening targets for this window (supporting evidence ev0625, ev0701).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check the distribution of errors across the 24 paired targets (the compare_forecast_actual pairs) to see whether errors are systematically negative in late-evening targets, and compare to MAE (ev0701).
